name: io.github.jkotzker/firesidefm-mcp-server
title: Fireside.fm (unofficial)
description: Unofficial server for the Fireside.fm podcast API: podcasts, episodes, downloads and drafts.

environmentVariables.name: FIRESIDE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Fireside API key, created at https://app.fireside.fm/api_tokens. A Read Only key offers only the read tools.

environmentVariables.name: FIRESIDE_PODCAST
environmentVariables.description: Token or slug of the podcast to use when a request does not name one.

environmentVariables.name: FIRESIDE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to offer only the read tools, even with a Read/Write key.
